mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200k, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based pickup in consumer demand, increasing corporate revenue visibility and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, increasing recession risk and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured by RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts indicates strong household demand, which elevates corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST rise (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC > -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.0%, or Rank IC > -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
